question.text: The first two stages of ODR (Pre-Conciliation and Conciliation) are:

answer.text: Free of cost for the investors

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandated both stages are free for investors. The Trap: Arbitration stage may have cost implications. Cross-Exam Context: Same fee structure in III-A ODR content. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Treat pre-conciliation seriously — rapid resolution improves NPS and avoids escalation.
